title: Conversational Board-Pack Q&A over the Numbers
pain: Board and ExCo members read a 120-page pack, then fire ad-hoc questions ('why did fee margin drop in EMEA?') at the FP&A team, triggering days of scramble and follow-up decks between meetings.
solution: A chat agent grounded on the actual board-pack workbooks, GL extracts and prior packs answers natural-language questions in seconds ('Which 3 clients drove the AUA dip?'), returns the number, the driver breakdown, and the source cell/page it came from.
how: RAG over structured financials + text-to-SQL/formula tool-calling with citation back to source cells and pack pages.
impact_metric: Ad-hoc board follow-up turnaround cut from ~2 days to under 2 minutes; ~90% of Q&A self-served

title: Auto-Generated CFO Board Commentary
pain: The FP&A lead spends 2-3 days each cycle hand-writing the CFO's board narrative — performance summary, key drivers, risks — reconciling wording against the latest numbers, which keep changing until the last minute.
solution: The agent ingests the final MI pack, computes material movements vs budget/prior/forecast, and drafts board-ready commentary in the CFO's house style with driver attribution, callouts, and a plain-English 'so what', regenerating instantly when numbers refresh.
how: Variance detection + templated LLM narrative generation conditioned on a tone/style exemplar corpus.
impact_metric: Commentary drafting time reduced ~85% (3 days to ~half a day of review)

title: One-Click Board Pack Assembly
pain: Compiling the monthly board pack means manually refreshing dozens of Excel tabs, pasting charts into PowerPoint, re-checking page order and formatting — a fragile, 1-2 day copy-paste marathon prone to stale-number errors.
solution: An agentic pipeline pulls the refreshed data model, regenerates every exhibit and chart, updates narrative sections, versions the pack, and outputs a formatted, branded PDF/PPTX with an automated tie-out check flagging any figure that doesn't reconcile.
how: Orchestrated data-refresh + template rendering pipeline with automated cross-exhibit reconciliation checks.
impact_metric: Pack assembly cut from ~16 hours to under 1 hour; near-zero paste errors

title: Natural-Language-to-Workbook Builder
pain: Analysts spend hours building bespoke models from scratch — 'build me a fund-level fee waterfall by client with a sensitivity toggle' — wiring formulas, ranges and formatting by hand.
solution: The user describes the workbook in plain English and the agent generates a fully-formulated, formatted Excel model (tabs, named ranges, live formulas, data validation, charts) wired to the source data, ready to run and audit.
how: LLM code-generation emitting Office-JS/openpyxl formula graphs from a natural-language spec.
impact_metric: Net-new model build time reduced ~70%; days to hours

title: Automated Variance Analysis & Commentary
pain: Every month analysts eyeball actuals vs budget across hundreds of P&L lines and cost centres, manually decompose the biggest swings, and type up 'what happened and why' commentary line by line.
solution: The engine ranks material variances by threshold and materiality, decomposes each into price/volume/mix/FX/timing drivers, and writes analyst-grade commentary with root-cause hypotheses linked to the underlying transactions.
how: Rules-based variance decomposition + driver attribution feeding an LLM commentary layer.
impact_metric: Variance commentary effort down ~80%; coverage of lines explained up from ~60% to 100%

title: Agentic Reforecast Engine
pain: Quarterly reforecasts are a multi-week grind of chasing cost-centre owners, re-keying inputs, rebuilding driver assumptions and reconciling a dozen submission templates into one consolidated view.
solution: An agent proposes a bottoms-up reforecast from actuals run-rate, pipeline and driver trends, pre-fills owner templates with a defensible starting point, flags outliers versus history, and consolidates submissions automatically with an audit trail of every assumption changed.
how: Time-series baselining + driver-based projection with agent-orchestrated template pre-fill and consolidation.
impact_metric: Reforecast cycle shortened from ~3 weeks to ~5 days; ~50% fewer submission iterations

title: Conversational Scenario & Sensitivity Modelling
pain: Answering 'what if we lose our two largest funds, FX moves 5%, and hiring slips a quarter?' means an analyst manually rebuilding scenario tabs each time leadership changes the question.
solution: Leadership asks scenarios in plain language; the agent flexes the driver-based model, runs the permutations, and returns the P&L / cash / margin impact with a waterfall and a written interpretation — instantly re-runnable as the question evolves.
how: Natural-language intent parsing mapped to a parameterised driver model executed on demand.
impact_metric: Scenario turnaround from hours/days to seconds; 10x more scenarios explored per decision

title: AUM/AUA-Driven Revenue Forecasting
pain: As a fund administrator, revenue tracks assets-under-administration, fee tiers and transaction volumes across thousands of client mandates — forecasting it in spreadsheets is coarse and slow to update.
solution: A model links AUA flows, fee schedules, mandate onboarding pipeline and churn to project fee revenue at client and segment granularity, auto-updating as market moves and flows land, with driver-level explainability.
how: Driver-based ML forecast on AUA/flow/fee-tier features with segment-level decomposition.
impact_metric: Forecast accuracy (MAPE) improved ~30-40%; monthly refresh vs quarterly

title: Investor & Client Reporting Pack Generation
pain: Producing hundreds of bespoke client/investor statement packs each quarter — each with its own template, fee breakdown, and performance narrative — is a heavily manual, deadline-driven bottleneck for the reporting team.
solution: The system generates each client's branded pack from their mandate data — performance, fees, holdings, capital account narrative — at scale, personalising commentary per client and routing exceptions for human review only where thresholds are breached.
how: Templated document generation at scale with per-client data binding and LLM-personalised narrative.
impact_metric: Reporting production capacity up ~5x; per-pack effort down ~75%

title: Management Deck & Slide Auto-Generation
pain: FP&A rebuilds the same monthly performance decks by hand — reformatting charts, updating titles with the latest numbers, re-writing takeaways — burning senior analyst time on production not insight.
solution: From the refreshed data model the agent produces a branded, on-message slide deck: chart selection, data-driven titles ('Fee margin fell 40bps on client mix'), speaker notes and an executive summary, ready to tweak rather than build.
how: Insight extraction + chart selection heuristics driving a brand-templated slide renderer.
impact_metric: Deck build time reduced ~75%; consistent branding across all outputs

title: KPI Narrative & Anomaly Callouts
pain: KPI dashboards show what moved but not why; leadership still emails analysts to interpret every notable spike or dip in margin, utilisation, DSO or AUA flows.
solution: Each KPI is auto-annotated with a plain-English narrative, trend context, and an anomaly flag when a metric breaks its expected band — surfacing the 'watch this' items before anyone has to ask.
how: Statistical anomaly detection per metric + LLM narrative annotation on each KPI tile.
impact_metric: ~90% of KPI interpretation questions pre-answered; issues surfaced days earlier

title: Excel Formula Auditor & Error Hunter
pain: Critical FP&A workbooks accumulate broken references, inconsistent formulas across a row, hardcoded overrides and circular logic — errors that surface embarrassingly in board numbers.
solution: The agent scans a workbook and flags formula inconsistencies, hardcodes buried in formula cells, broken links, sign errors and off-by-one ranges, explaining each risk in plain English and proposing a fix.
how: Formula-graph static analysis with LLM-explained risk ranking.
impact_metric: Spreadsheet error detection ~10x faster; material-error incidents cut sharply

title: Legacy Workbook Documentation & Reverse-Engineering
pain: Business-critical models are undocumented and understood by one person; when they leave, the logic is a black box nobody dares change.
solution: The agent parses a workbook and produces a human-readable spec: what each tab does, the calculation logic, inputs/outputs, dependencies and assumptions — turning tribal knowledge into documentation and reducing key-person risk.
how: Formula-dependency tracing summarised into structured documentation by an LLM.
impact_metric: Model documentation time cut ~90%; key-person risk materially reduced

title: Board & ExCo Meeting Prep Brief
pain: Before each board or ExCo meeting the CFO's team manually assembles a briefing — likely questions, sensitive movements, prior action items, and talking points — from scattered packs and emails.
solution: The agent reads the current pack plus prior minutes and action logs to produce a pre-read brief: top 5 likely questions with model-backed answers, red-flag movements, status of prior actions, and suggested talking points.
how: Multi-source RAG over packs, minutes and action logs with anticipatory Q&A generation.
impact_metric: Meeting prep time cut ~70%; fewer 'we'll come back to you' moments

title: Finance Policy & Methodology Knowledge Assistant
pain: Analysts constantly ping seniors for 'how do we treat this fee?', 'what's the intercompany recharge policy?', 'which cost centre owns this?' — answers buried in wikis, policy PDFs and people's heads.
solution: A grounded assistant answers finance policy, methodology, chart-of-accounts and process questions with citations to the source policy document, available 24/7 across a global team.
how: RAG over policy docs, CoA and process wikis with source-cited answers.
impact_metric: Routine policy queries deflected ~60%; onboarding ramp cut by weeks

title: Automated Data Reconciliation & Tie-Out Agent
pain: Reporting teams manually tie out numbers across the GL, the data warehouse, and the board pack — chasing why two 'sources of truth' disagree by a few thousand — before every publish.
solution: The agent reconciles figures across systems and reports, isolates the breaking records, classifies the likely cause (timing, FX, mapping, duplication), and drafts the reconciliation note — flagging only true exceptions for humans.
how: Automated cross-source matching with LLM classification of break root-cause.
impact_metric: Reconciliation effort down ~70%; breaks resolved same-day

title: Client Fee & Margin Deep-Dive Analytics
pain: Understanding profitability at client/mandate level — effective fee rate vs cost-to-serve, margin leakage, under-priced mandates — requires bespoke pulls that rarely get done at scale.
solution: An analytics agent computes client-level margin, ranks profitability outliers, detects fee leakage and scope-creep, and produces a narrated deep-dive with re-pricing candidates for commercial review.
how: Client-level cost-allocation analytics with LLM-narrated outlier surfacing.
impact_metric: Margin-leakage identified worth basis points of revenue; analysis at 100% client coverage

title: Natural-Language Ad-Hoc Analytics ('Ask the Data')
pain: Every 'quick question' from leadership ('headcount cost by region trending vs last year?') becomes an analyst pulling and pivoting data — a queue of interruptions that crowds out real analysis.
solution: A self-serve conversational layer over the finance data model lets non-technical stakeholders ask questions in English and get charts, tables and a written answer, with governed access and source transparency.
how: Text-to-SQL over a governed semantic layer with auto-visualisation.
impact_metric: Ad-hoc data requests to FP&A down ~65%; answers in seconds not days

title: Cost-Centre Owner Commentary Chaser & Drafter
pain: Chasing dozens of budget owners for their monthly spend commentary — then rewriting their terse or missing notes into usable narrative — is a recurring low-value time sink for the FP&A team.
solution: The agent auto-drafts each owner's variance commentary from their actuals, sends it for a one-click confirm-or-edit, and escalates only non-responders — flipping the workflow from chasing blank boxes to approving pre-written drafts.
how: Per-owner variance narrative generation with human-in-the-loop confirmation workflow.
impact_metric: Commentary collection cycle cut ~60%; owner effort reduced to a quick review

title: Report Consistency & Number-Integrity Checker
pain: The same metric can differ across the board pack, the investor report and the exec deck due to version drift — an embarrassing and trust-eroding error that's hard to catch manually.
solution: Before publishing, the agent cross-checks every figure appearing in multiple documents, flags mismatches with the discrepancy and likely source, and verifies narrative claims against the underlying numbers ('says up 12%, data says 9%').
how: Cross-document figure extraction + narrative-to-data consistency verification.
impact_metric: Cross-report inconsistencies caught pre-publish ~100%; rework and errata near-zero

title: FP&A Onboarding & Process Copilot
pain: New FP&A joiners take months to learn the close calendar, the models, the systems and 'how we do things here', leaning heavily on scarce senior time.
solution: An in-context copilot walks new joiners through processes, explains where data lives, answers 'how do I run the reforecast', and surfaces the right template or SOP at the moment of need — an always-available mentor.
how: RAG over SOPs, calendars and system docs with task-aware guided workflows.
impact_metric: Time-to-productivity for new analysts cut ~40%; senior mentoring load reduced

title: Predictive Cash & Liquidity Forecasting
pain: Cash forecasting relies on static spreadsheets and manual receivables assumptions, giving treasury a lagging, low-confidence view of the firm's liquidity position.
solution: A model projects cash by learning payment-timing patterns from receivables/payables history, client-specific behaviour and billing cycles, producing a probabilistic short- and medium-term cash forecast with driver explanations and alerting on shortfalls.
how: Payment-timing ML on AR/AP history producing a probabilistic cash projection.
impact_metric: Cash forecast accuracy improved ~25-35%; earlier visibility on liquidity risk
